exercises.expectedEvidence: No failed or unapplied required migration and recorded execution duration.
exercises.abortCondition: Migration status reports failure, unexpected drift, or target identity mismatch.

exercises.expectedEvidence: Schema, representative row counts, tenant integrity, migration status, and audit-chain checks pass.
exercises.abortCondition: Target name is not isolated or any integrity check fails.

exercises.expectedEvidence: All Deployments become ready and in-flight jobs complete or recover without duplicate settlement.
exercises.abortCondition: Readiness fails, queue age grows beyond five minutes, or settlement reconciliation fails.

exercises.expectedEvidence: Root cause is documented, one audited canary replay succeeds, and queue/dead-letter metrics recover.
exercises.abortCondition: Original external side effect is uncertain or canary creates a duplicate.

exercises.expectedEvidence: Settlement workers are paused, chain state is independently reconciled, and affected transactions are recorded.
exercises.abortCondition: Chain state cannot be independently established or signer access is not contained.
